start_with: Inspect the Step’s current status.
Confirm that the status is configured as an **Is Complete** status in the Step Program.
Confirm that both the completion date and completion status are present.
If a workflow should have launched, inspect the program- or type-level trigger and installed Rock version.
Stop when both completion signals are correct and the expected downstream behavior has been rechecked. (Edit Step Programs)
branches.title: A Step has a completion date but is not counted as complete
branches.when: A Step has a completion date but is not counted as complete

do_not_assume: Do not assume Data View membership overrides prerequisites or repeat limits.
start_with: Confirm the person currently qualifies for the Auto-Complete Data View.
Confirm the Steps Automation job has processed the Step Type.
Inspect unmet prerequisite Steps.
If a record already exists, inspect **Allow Multiple** before expecting another occurrence.
Do not assume Data View membership overrides prerequisites or repeat limits. (Edit Step Types)
branches.title: Step automation did not create or complete a record
branches.when: Step automation did not create or complete a record

start_with: Confirm the badge is a Person badge of type Steps and points to the complete program.
Confirm the badge was added to the Person Profile badge container.
Confirm the Step Type has **Show Count on Badge** enabled.
Confirm the badge uses Normal display mode; the setting does not affect other modes. (Steps Badges)
branches.title: A Steps badge appears but its count does not
branches.when: A Steps badge appears but its count does not

start_with: Determine whether the metric counts Step occurrences or distinct people.
Check whether the Step Type permits multiple completions.
Inspect the chart’s status filter: completed statuses use completion dates; other statuses use start dates.
For impact measures, inspect every applicable Step Type’s Impact Weight.
For a Step Flow chart, inspect the maximum displayed level before interpreting apparent drop-off. (Intro to Step Programs, Intro to Step Charts, Chart Types)
branches.title: Step metrics or charts appear inflated or use unexpected dates
branches.when: Step metrics or charts appear inflated or use unexpected dates

start_with: Confirm the person’s enrollment date.
Inspect the occurrence map for eligible dates after enrollment.
Determine whether the engagement map contains participation.
If historical attendance should populate the map, consider an individual rebuild.
Before rebuilding, record any manual engagement-map changes because the rebuild deletes them. (Intro to Streak Enrollment, Rebuild Streaks Individually)
branches.title: A manually enrolled person has a streak of zero
branches.when: A manually enrolled person has a streak of zero

start_with: Distinguish an occurrence-map edit from an individual engagement- or exclusion-map edit.
For an individual map edit, save and refresh the page.
For an occurrence-map edit, confirm that the nightly cleanup job has run.
Inspect enrollment dates because earlier dates remain outside each person’s calculation. (Streak Type Detail, Manually Track Streaks)
branches.title: A Streak Type map was changed but participant totals have not updated
branches.when: A Streak Type map was changed but participant totals have not updated

do_not_assume: Do not treat the visible absence as proof of a calculation error: exclusions do not alter attendance data.
start_with: Inspect the person’s exclusion map and applicable location exclusions.
Confirm whether that date was excluded.
Do not treat the visible absence as proof of a calculation error: exclusions do not alter attendance data.
Confirm that the excluded date neither added to nor interrupted the calculated streak. (Exclude a Date)
branches.title: A streak spans a date that still looks absent
branches.when: A streak spans a date that still looks absent

start_with: Inspect **Minimum Days to Re-take** on the installed Assessment Type.
Compare the previous completion date with that interval.
Inspect **Requires Request**.
If a request is required, confirm that a valid pending request exists.
Check the external My Account and results-page paths only after the policy conditions pass. (Retake Assessments)
branches.title: A person cannot retake an assessment
branches.when: A person cannot retake an assessment

start_with: Open the person’s assessment history.
Confirm whether the entry is requested or self-initiated.
Inspect its completion status and completion date.
Stop if the assessment is complete; completed requests cannot be deleted or canceled through this operation. (View Assessment History)
branches.title: An assessment request cannot be canceled
branches.when: An assessment request cannot be canceled

start_with: Interpret stored progress as a decimal fraction, not a whole-number percentage.
Check whether `1` has made the attempt successful.
Inspect whether **Allow Overachievement** permits display above 100 percent.
Confirm that overachievement and Max Accomplishments are not being expected simultaneously.
Determine whether the attempt is still open, closed successfully or closed unsuccessfully.
Consider a rebuild only after documenting that it recalculates attempt data after each person’s latest success. (Add Achievement Attempts, Achievement Types)
branches.title: Achievement progress or attempt state looks wrong
branches.when: Achievement progress or attempt state looks wrong

start_with: Confirm the Reminder Type’s entity type, security and notification mode.
Confirm that the reminder date has arrived.
Confirm that the Process Reminders job includes the type and does not exclude it.
For Communication mode, inspect the job’s selected system communication.
For Workflow mode, inspect the configured workflow and expected supplied attributes.
Check whether automatic completion changed the reminder’s status after notification. (Configure Notification Types, Use the Process Reminders System Job)
branches.title: A Reminder was created but no notification occurred
branches.when: A Reminder was created but no notification occurred

start_with: Confirm that the recipient follows the person or group.
Confirm that the event is enabled in the recipient’s Following Settings.
Confirm that the recipient has View permission for the Following Event at generation time.
Inspect the event’s filters and lookback window.
Account for daily evaluation rather than assuming immediate delivery.
For Person History matching, inspect Match Both and blank-value wildcard behavior. (How to Follow, Configure Follow Events, Person History Following Event)
branches.title: A Following notification is missing

start_with: Confirm that the question is currently shown and not closed.
Confirm that the response was submitted to the intended experience.
If moderation is enabled, inspect whether the response awaits approval or was rejected.
Inspect campus filtering in the manager or presenter view.
If audience restrictions are involved, inspect the schedule’s Data View or group-membership condition. (Intro to Interactive Experiences, Use the Experience Manager)
branches.title: An Interactive Experience response is missing from the visualizer
branches.when: An Interactive Experience response is missing from the visualizer

start_with: For registration or reminder communication errors, confirm that an organization phone number is configured for the SMS-enabled system communication.
For a registration route, verify project, location, schedule and, when applicable, group IdKeys.
Remember that the project parameter represents the Sign-Up group.
For attendance, confirm the occurrence date uses `yyyy-MM-dd`.
Inspect project or group-type permissions before changing attendee records. (Configure Sign-Ups, Group Registration and Attendance for Sign-Ups, Configure Sign-Up Permissions)
branches.title: A Sign-Up communication or attendance link fails
branches.when: A Sign-Up communication or attendance link fails

entrypoint: Choose the branch whose symptom matches the user's task, then inspect the live records before making changes.
